description:
Senior
 Java / Web Developer with 5+ years of experience in different Java 
frameworks and UI design and web application development.

Expert in responsive UI design using Java, HTML5, Angular JS, 
JQuery, React JS, CSS and other frameworks like Spring MVC, Spring 
Batch, multi threading, web services etc.

Experience in building online forms and dashboards is a plus.

Application server knowledge specifically JBoss and SQL DB is mandatory.

Experience with DB2, Oracle will be a plus.

Experienced in build and continuous integration tools like maven, jenkinks, bamboo, Lara etc.

Candidate should be able to work independently with minimal supervision.

Should be able to understand and enhance on requirements and come up with a design and implement the same. 



 Skill : Java, HTML5, Angular JS, JQuery, React JS, CSS


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
